panels.title: Asset Daily Workorder Volume (30d)
panels.description: Live panel for outcomes.asset_metrics[$asset_id].workorder_volume backed by the workorders table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(COALESCE(workorder_created_at, handoff_completed_at, workorder_completed_at, NOW()), '1d'),
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM workorders
WHERE asset_id = '${asset_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(workorder_created_at, handoff_completed_at, workorder_completed_at, NOW()))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Asset Acceptance Rate (30d)
panels.description: Live panel for outcomes.asset_metrics[$asset_id].acceptance_rate backed by rca_feedback accept and reject actions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_feedback AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'),
    SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'accept' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS accepted_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'reject' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS rejected_count
  FROM rca_feedback
  WHERE asset_id = '${asset_id}'
    AND action IN ('accept', 'reject')
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  time,
  accepted_count / NULLIF(accepted_count + rejected_count, 0) AS value
FROM daily_feedback
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CMMS Success Total
panels.description: Leadership KPI aligned with outcomes.cmms_summary.success_total for the active dashboard window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cmms_proposals AS (
  SELECT
    p.proposal_id,
    p.status,
    p.work_order_id,
    p.created_at,
    p.metadata,
    w.handoff_completed_at,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'handoff_state'), ''),
        CASE
          WHEN p.status = 'approved' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.work_order_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'success'
          ELSE 'pending'
        END
      )
    ) AS handoff_state,
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval_attempts') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.metadata->'approval_attempts')
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval') = 'object'
        AND (
          NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_by'), '') IS NOT NULL
        ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS attempt_count,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), ''),
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '')
    )::timestamptz AS approved_at
  FROM pm_proposals p
  LEFT JOIN workorders w ON w.wo_id = p.work_order_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.created_at)
)
SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_state = 'success')::double precision AS value
FROM cmms_proposals

panels.title: CMMS Avg Approval to Handoff

targets.rawSql:
WITH cmms_proposals AS (
  SELECT
    p.proposal_id,
    p.status,
    p.work_order_id,
    p.created_at,
    p.metadata,
    w.handoff_completed_at,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'handoff_state'), ''),
        CASE
          WHEN p.status = 'approved' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.work_order_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'success'
          ELSE 'pending'
        END
      )
    ) AS handoff_state,
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval_attempts') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.metadata->'approval_attempts')
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval') = 'object'
        AND (
          NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_by'), '') IS NOT NULL
        ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS attempt_count,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), ''),
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '')
    )::timestamptz AS approved_at
  FROM pm_proposals p
  LEFT JOIN workorders w ON w.wo_id = p.work_order_id

panels.title: CMMS Breakdown by Asset
panels.description: Operational drill-down aligned with outcomes.cmms_breakdowns.by_asset for the active dashboard window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cmms_proposals AS (
  SELECT
    p.proposal_id,
    p.status,
    p.work_order_id,
    p.asset_id AS proposal_asset_id,
    w.asset_id AS workorder_asset_id,
    p.metadata AS proposal_metadata,
    w.metadata AS workorder_metadata,
    w.handoff_completed_at,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'handoff_state'), ''),
        CASE
          WHEN p.status = 'approved' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.work_order_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'success'
          ELSE 'pending'
        END
      )
    ) AS handoff_state,
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval_attempts') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.metadata->'approval_attempts')
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval') = 'object'
        AND (
          NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_by'), '') IS NOT NULL
        ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS attempt_count,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'approved_at'), ''),
      NULLIF(BTRIM(p.metadata->'approval'->>'attempted_at'), '')
    )::timestamptz AS approved_at
  FROM pm_proposals p
  LEFT JOIN workorders w ON w.wo_id = p.work_order_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.created_at)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(proposal_asset_id, workorder_asset_id, '')), ''), 'unknown') AS asset_id,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_state = 'success')::bigint AS success_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_state = 'pending')::bigint AS pending_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_state = 'failure')::bigint AS failure_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'approved' AND attempt_count > 0)::bigint AS admin_retry_required_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'approved' AND attempt_count >= ${pm_handoff_max_attempts})::bigint AS limit_reached_total,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (handoff_completed_at - approved_at))) FILTER (
    WHERE approved_at IS NOT NULL
      AND handoff_completed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND handoff_completed_at >= approved_at
  )::double precision AS approval_to_handoff_seconds_avg
FROM cmms_proposals
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY failure_total DESC, pending_total DESC, admin_retry_required_total DESC, asset_id ASC

          ELSE 'pending'
        END
      )
    ) AS handoff_state,
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.metadata->'approval_attempts') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.metadata->'approval_attempts')

ORDER BY failure_total DESC, pending_total DESC, admin_retry_required_total DESC, backend ASC
